Incident: {batch} gear blanks, 2,000 pieces, material 20CrMnTi, requiring surface hardness of HRC 58~62 and effective case depth of 0.8~1.2 mm after carburizing and quenching. 30 pieces were sampled; measured hardness was HRC 51.5~53.0 and case depth 0.42~0.55 mm; all 30 pieces were below the lower limit, with none conforming. Work order body / {ticket}

Batch: {batch} | Production line: No. 3 machining line | Date: {date}
Product: hydraulic valve body (drawing number VB-2231) | Sample quantity: 50 pieces

I. Actual measurements
The drawing requires the inner bore diameter to be 20.00~20.10 mm. Among the 50 pieces sampled from this batch, 12 pieces measured 20.14~20.19 mm, exceeding the upper limit by 0.04~0.09 mm; all no-go gauge inspections passed, roundness 0.008 mm is qualified, and surface roughness Ra1.6 is qualified. The same 12 pieces from the batch were re-measured with a second CMM, and the results were consistent, ruling out gauge error. Tracing the tool ledger, the boring tool wear compensation of {device} had not been updated for 3 consecutive days, and the out-of-tolerance pieces were concentrated among the 12 pieces processed during that period.

II. Determination
The main defect is dimensional out-of-tolerance and does not involve surface, assembly, or material issues; the remaining 38 pieces are all within the tolerance band. The 12 pieces have a 0.25 mm machining allowance and can be returned to the CNC lathe for rework and then re-reamed; the rework time per piece is about 11 minutes, and the pass rate of re-inspection after rework is estimated at 96%. This batch is not allowed to be directly rejected as scrap and shall follow the rework process; any pieces still out of tolerance after rework shall be submitted to {customer} for approval as concession acceptance.

III. Remarks
1) On {date}, the No. 2 air compressor will undergo maintenance, which is unrelated to this determination; 2) this morning a recruiting HRBP came to the workshop to borrow 2 operators for a campus recruitment presentation, and staffing arrangements have been coordinated separately; 3) at month-end settlement, system concurrency increased, and MES data return was delayed by about 8 minutes, which does not affect the actual measurement records for this order.

Internal Email
Subject: Unqualified Hardness of Heat Treatment for {batch} Connecting Rods and Disposition Opinion for the Entire Batch (Urgent)

To: Production Department, Quality Department, {customer} contact
Cc: Process Team

I. Facts
Order {order_no} has a total of 800 connecting rods; quenching and tempering were completed on {date}. 15 pieces were sampled; measured hardness is HRC 28.6~31.2, while the drawing requires HRC 38~42; the lowest value is 9.4 below the lower limit; metallography shows uneven tempered sorbite structure and local ferrite bands. The main defect is judged as a material or heat treatment defect; surface and dimensions are both qualified.

II. Why It Cannot Be Reworked
This batch has been precision-ground to finished dimensions, with only 0.06 mm allowance per side; re-quenching will cause 0.12~0.18 mm deformation, and the decarburized layer cannot be removed; after rework, it still cannot meet both hardness and dimensional requirements.

III. Risk Verification
3 pieces were taken for bench tests; under 4200 N alternating load, all 3 pieces fractured; measured safety factor is 1.1, while the design requirement is not less than 1.8. This part is a load-bearing part of the traveling mechanism; after installation on the vehicle, there is a risk of fracture failure, which is fatal-level and does not accept concession acceptance.

IV. Disposition
All 800 pieces are to be directly scrapped; no sorting and no downgraded use; they have been isolated in the nonconforming product area and marked with red tags. {customer} has been notified to supply another 800 pieces, and the delivery date is postponed to {date}.

V. Others
The matter of pressure fluctuation of No. 3 air compressor has been transferred to the Equipment Section and is unrelated to this order; regarding the overtime meal allowance list asked about by a recruiting HRBP, please have Administration reply separately; during month-end settlement, the financial system has high concurrency; I will supplement the scrap order tomorrow morning; please take this email as the current basis.
